questions.question: How is God addressed at the start of Psalm 94?
options: O LORD, God of great mercy

questions.question: What rhetorical question rebukes those who think God does not notice?
options: Who has measured all of the waters of the sea in the hollow of his own hand?
He who planted the ear, does he not hear? He who formed the eye, does he not see?
Who has set the fixed boundaries of the sea so that it would not pass beyond them?
Who gives food to the young ravens out in the field when they cry aloud to him?
questions.answer: He who planted the ear, does he not hear? He who formed the eye, does he not see?
